intent: The horseshoe magnet eases in from below and snaps toward the needle; the meter needle swings past the red zone and rebounds to center with springy damping.
The outer gimbal rocks gently while the inner rotor spins fast around its center dot, then precesses in a smooth looping wobble as a polished lab icon.
Logo animation: the gear ring rotates a quarter turn with a crisp mechanical ease while the shift lever snaps from low-left to upper-right and rebounds once into the gate.
Logo animation: the lever handle pivots downward around the left pin, driving the press block straight down with a tiny squash on impact before both return to the drawn pose.
Logo animation: the base gear spins briefly, the robot arm swings outward in two hinged segments, and the claw pinches closed with a precise servo tick.
Logo animation: the ringed planet scales up with a soft overshoot, then the orbital ring sweeps around it once while two small moons drift into their positions and settle.
Logo animation: the crescent rotates in from the left like a hinged charm, the star pops on with a bright elastic scale, and the small dot sparkles once before holding.
Logo animation: the spiral arms unfurl from the center in a clockwise swirl, the core blooms last, and the mark finishes with a slow celestial drift.
Logo animation: the wave slides in from the left with a soft overshoot, the shell rises from behind it and opens into place with a tiny bounce, then the foam dot pops on last.
Logo animation: the crescent fades in first, the hull glides gently onto the water, and the two sails unfurl upward with staggered ease as the whole mark rocks once.
Logo animation: the surf oval squashes into view, the crab body pops up from the wave, then both claws snap upward in a playful alternating motion before settling.
Logo animation: the sand base wipes on, the umbrella canopy fans open from the center hinge in three colorful panels, and the pole swings down to lock with a crisp stop.
Logo animation: the record spins one smooth turn while the note stem bobs upward and settles back with a soft elastic ease.
Logo animation: the headphone arc draws down into the ear pads, then the central sound wave pulses three times with alternating tall and short peaks.
Logo animation: the metronome arm ticks left, right, and returns to center with crisp mechanical easing while the small note pops on the final beat.
Logo animation: the mug slides in from the left and eases to a stop while the handle pops outward; the steam curls rise and fade in staggered loops.
Logo animation: the calendar drops in page-first, the binding dots bounce, and the checkmark sweeps across the date grid with a confident overshoot.
Logo animation: the ruler slides diagonally into place first, the pencil spins once around its center and locks parallel, then both give a tiny measuring-tap bounce.
Logo intro: the soil mound squashes in from a flat oval, then the two sprout leaves unfurl upward with a soft overshoot and settle into the circular badge.
The watering can slides in with a tiny tilt, three water drops fall in staggered arcs, and the leaf beneath springs open as if freshly watered.
The gate draws open from the center like two hinged doors while the vine curls upward around the arch and the leaves pop into place with quick scale bounces.
The carrot drops into the ground point-first with a soft bounce, then the leafy top fans out in three overlapping sweeps and settles with a small wiggle.
The taxi badge slides in from the curb side, the checkered band snaps across the car body, and the wheels give a quick half-turn before stopping crisply.
At dusk, the lamp head eases down on its pole and turns on with a warm glow that expands once, while the moon drifts slightly behind it.
The die tumbles in with a snappy quarter-turn, the face dots bounce into place with elastic easing, and the square settles as if landing on a table.
The yo-yo disc drops down its string, spins with a quick blur-like rotation, then rebounds upward slightly and hangs centered with a playful ease-out.
The top twists rapidly around its center peg, wobbles in a small cone-shaped precession, then straightens and gives one final sparkle-like snap.
Logo intro: the circular badge scales up with a soft overshoot, then the hammer drops in from above and gives one tiny rebound as if striking into place.
The screwdriver rotates a half turn around the center while the background square tilts slightly the opposite way, then both ease into a clean vertical-diagonal lockup.
The clamp frame draws together as a logo mark: the top jaw slides down, pauses in a compressed hold, then springs back a few pixels with a satisfying mechanical bounce.
